doc.title: Bobby Watson interviewed by Michael Woods, Clinton, New York, January 19, 1996

title: Closing remarks
summary: Woods praises the answer and thanks Watson, ending the interview.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Listen, this has been absolutely marvelous. What an answer. I want to say this, look straight into the camera and say this, this has been one of the most articulate statements that we’ve had on where jazz may be going in the future. You heard this from Bobby Watson. That means all you students that are interested in jazz, you really have to be eclectic. Learn to do it all. You just heard it from one of the masters. That’s great. Listen, we’ve got to let you go.
Get something to eat and detox. This has been absolutely fabulous. And this ends our interview with Bobby Watson for Hamilton Jazz Archive.
